_: Ten of Phobos's people (the owner, 2026-11-19: 'you may use my meshy account to generate 10 people who would live in Phobos'). Made by tools/phobos/residents.mjs: Meshy text-to-3D preview, refined with PBR textures, rigged; saved in art/phobos/residents/. Every prompt keeps the V/T rule: no text, letters, emblems or crosses, no blue beside gold; Velscour's own people in his blood red. Thirty more on 2026-11-19 ('Add 30 more inhabitants of Phobos via Meshy'): sex 'f' marks who takes the townswoman's fingers. Twenty more, 2026-11-19 ('Make up to 20 additional characters ... for the different areas within phobos, and creatures that might inhabit Velscour's keep/castle'): area says where in the city they live; castle ones stand in the castle's wards. Sixty more, 2026-11-19 ('Generate another 60 people in Meshy to spread across all the different areas of Phobos, to replace repeated characters'): six give a body of their own to city folk who'd borrowed one from the land's people, fifty-four more take the place of palette swaps. Five of the sixty held back till the account's credits renew (in 'held'): there were enough for fifty-five.
style: Realistic 3D game character for a dark, grim medieval fantasy RPG, full body, standing in a T-pose with arms straight out and empty open hands, front view, plain grey background, PBR. No text, no letters, no logos, no emblems, no crosses, no blue, no gold.
